newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aristocrat says 96/97 sales in line.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aristocrat says 96/97 sales in line.

text.p: Gaming machine maker Aristocrat Leisure Ltd said sales so far in the 1996/97 financial year were in line with forecasts from its prospectus issued in June.

"We are pleased with the strength in our sales to date in this financial year, particularly in NSW (New South Wales) where the market has been resilient, despite the traditional cyclical downturn at this time of the year," managing director Gary Garton said in a statement.
Aristocrat earlier reported an operating profit of A$24.08 million in the year to June 30, 1996, above the prospectus forecast of A$23.7 million.
Aristocrat's sales were A$256.92 million in 1995/96, compared with a prospectus forecast of A$259 million.
At 1.20 p.m. (0320 GMT), Aristocrat shares were five cents up at A$3.30.
Shares in the Sydney-based group were issued at A$2.90 each.
